clues.title: Language: Language - Marathi

Marathi uses Western Full Stops '.' , while Hindi uses Devanagari full stops '।'
This letter: ण is more common in Marathi (but not exclusive)
Marathi does NOT use those dots (nukta) on the bottom left of a character: ज़
